title: Matter — Open Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/matters. Opens a new Matter (multi-fabric deal-room container). Caller becomes the first member with role=owner. See docs/v2-prep/matters-spec-draft.md §24.5.

name.description: Human-readable Matter name. Free-form; implementations MAY enforce additional uniqueness.

opened_by_display.description: Caller's display name within the Matter. Defaults to the caller's principal_id if omitted.
